pictures.name: ZSD1-Pir-Arrives
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters or writing of any script (no Gurmukhi), no logos or modern objects. Gentle and peaceful, no violence, no injury. Foothills of the Himalaya by a river in the late 1600s: an elderly Sufi saint with a long white beard, a green robe and a tall green felt cap rides a horse at the head of a band of his followers toward a camp of Sikh tents. Morning mist, pine trees, gold light. Loyal, brave.

pictures.name: ZSD2-Combing
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters or writing of any script (no Gurmukhi), no logos or modern objects. Gentle and peaceful, no violence, no injury. Inside a simple tent at morning: Guru Gobind Singh, seen only from behind, sits cross-legged, his very long uncut dark hair loose down his back, combing it with a small wooden comb. A folded blue turban cloth and a sheathed small sword rest beside him. At the tent door, the elderly Sufi saint with a long white beard, green robe and tall green cap watches with love. The Guru is seen only from directly behind or very far away: no face, no profile, no cheek, no partial face is ever visible.

pictures.name: ZSD5-Five-Ks
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters or writing of any script (no Gurmukhi), no logos or modern objects. Gentle and peaceful, no violence, no injury. A still life on a folded white cloth in warm lamplight: a plain steel bracelet (kara), a small wooden comb (kanga), a small curved sword in a cloth sheath (kirpan), folded white cotton undershorts (kachera), and a neatly tied saffron turban suggesting uncut hair beneath (kesh). Deep blue shadows, reverent, simple.

pictures.name: ZSD6-Today-Kara
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting in the same style, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. A modern scene painted like an old master. No readable text, letters or writing of any script (no Gurmukhi), no logos. A modern office meeting room: a young Sikh woman in a blazer, hair tied, sits at a laptop in a tense meeting; she quietly turns the plain steel kara on her wrist with her other hand, her face calming. Window light, deep blue shadows, a private moment of remembering.
